blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A person’s past should not dictate their future. This principle took center stage in Iligan City on Thursday, October 29, as local officials and the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) launched a P1.34-million comprehensive reintegration program to help former Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) successfully rejoin society. Dubbed the Freedom Program Ordinance, the initiative was formally rolled out at the Iligan City Jail-Male Dormitory to institutionalize local government support for post-incarceration rehabilitation. “The F.R.E.E.D.O.M. Program sends a powerful message: a person’s past should not define his future,” Jail Supt. Carlo Obrique, warden of the […]...
